html:
The Wadjalang, also known as the Dharawala, are an Aboriginal people of southwest Queensland, in country along the Warrego River and its tributaries around present day Charleville.

Their neighbours on the map include the Gunggari and Nguri to the east, the Bidjara to the north and the Kuungkari to the northwest. Pastoralists took up the Warrego country in the 1860s. Little else is recorded about them. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Wadjalang, also known as the Dharawala, are an Aboriginal people of southwest Queensland, in country along the Warrego River and its tributaries around present day Charleville.
